title:
🌺Strike up a chord with Uke Group North CIC on Tuesdays in Ramsbottom!

🪕No experience required. Beginners and experienced players welcomed!

🪕No ukulele? No problem, hire one of ours for the duration of session for additional £2!

🐏Ramsbottom Library, Carr St. - 10:30am-12pm - £8pp

🐏The Den, Stubbins Vale Rd. - 5:30-7pm - £6pp

please email ukegroupnorth@gmail.com for more information on how to reserve your space.

Please use your local libraries and get involved in your local community centres, they are more likely to stay open if we use them!

visit: www.rammymen.org to find out more about their incredible work in the Ramsbottom community, check out their excellent list of activities, such as:

Thai Chi/Qigong - Tuesday 4pm-5pm. A fantastic way to focus the body and mind before playing some music with all of us at Uke Group North CIC!
